assets.name: otter_ref
assets.prompt: Turn this plush toy into a 2D cartoon game hero called Otter: a lovable, mischievous brown river otter. Keep the toy's identity: deep chocolate-brown curly fluffy fur, a wide cream muzzle and cream tummy, a big shiny black nose, small rounded ears, chunky short arms and legs. assets.name: mosey_ref
assets.prompt: Redraw this plush toy as ONE single 2D cartoon character illustration (one figure only: not a character sheet, no extra poses, no labels, no scenery, no water). He is a cute, friendly male mosasaur, a prehistoric sea reptile (not a land dinosaur, whale, shark or dolphin). Keep the toy's identity: bright ocean-blue body, a soft pale-grey bobbly frill running along his back and a second frill along his side, pale turquoise belly, golden-amber eyes, exactly four long paddle-shaped swimming flippers edged with pale frill, and a long aquatic tail ending in a fluke. Rounded friendly snout, gentle closed-mouth smile with small neat white pointed teeth with slightly rounded tips peeking out along the edge of his upper jaw (he is a mosasaur), still warm and friendly, never fierce, large expressive eyes with bright highlights and no eyelashes, a slightly bold brow, a cheeky boyish grin, and nothing round his neck. Relaxed floating pose, side-on three-quarter view with his head pointing to the RIGHT of the picture, whole body including tail and all four flippers visible.
